questions.answer: Personal and socially situated practices and expressions of loss.

questions.prompt: Does a cultural label determine preferences?
What if local cultural protocol is unfamiliar?
questions.answer: Seek appropriate invited local expertise and respect variation.
Consent, privacy, equitable access and legitimate obligations.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Compares cultural and individual preferences and proposes accessible, consent-based accommodations with appropriate limits.
scoring.transfer: Draft a fictional accommodation plan for a bereaved learner. Include preferred communication, two scheduling options, invited cultural consultation if appropriate, and an alternative for someone who prefers privacy. State which local details require verification.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
